summary: Li Auto Inc. filed a Form 6-K with a May 2026 delivery update, reporting 33,350 vehicles delivered and cumulative deliveries of 1,702,792. This is a routine monthly operational disclosure by a foreign private issuer, not a special situation. The filing describes product launches, retail expansion, and charging station growth. No transaction, activist campaign, strategic review, or structural change is involved. The update is purely operational and forward-looking, with no deal terms or special-situation mechanics.
